rows.corpus_definition: a range of different types of things
rows.example_en: There is a wide variety of fruit in the shop.

rows.corpus_definition: A collection of many different types of things.
rows.example_en: This shop sells a wide variety of snacks.

rows.corpus_definition: a decorative container used for holding flowers or water
rows.example_en: She placed the roses carefully in a tall glass vase.

rows.corpus_definition: A long-distance chat where you can see the other person.
rows.example_en: We had a video call with our family.

rows.corpus_definition: A digital game played on a computer or television screen.
rows.example_en: He plays a video game after school.

rows.corpus_definition: Someone who goes to see a person or a place.
rows.example_en: The museum welcomes every visitor with a smile.

rows.corpus_definition: to choose your leader or preference in an election.
rows.example_en: Everyone has the right to vote.

rows.corpus_definition: a vehicle with four wheels pulled by a horse
rows.example_en: The farmer loaded hay onto the wooden wagon.

rows.corpus_definition: A large piece of furniture used for hanging up clothes.
rows.example_en: She hung her new dress in the large wooden wardrobe.

rows.corpus_definition: to clean the plates, cups, and cutlery used for eating
rows.example_en: I will wash up after we finish our meal.

rows.corpus_definition: to use something in a bad way so it is gone
rows.example_en: Do not waste your time playing games all day.

rows.corpus_definition: Things that are not needed and are thrown away.
rows.example_en: We should put our waste in the bin.
